_comment: Node.js built-in support in Cloudflare Workers. 'v1' modules work with nodejs_compat at any compatibility date (node: prefix required before v2). 'v2' modules need nodejs_compat with compatibility_date >= v2_date (or the nodejs_compat_v2 flag). 'runtime_error' modules can be imported with nodejs_compat but their main APIs throw. 'fs' is a virtual filesystem: project files are not present at runtime. See 'calibration' for how each entry was checked.

alternatives.child_process: Workers cannot spawn processes. Use a Container, a Sandbox, or an external service over fetch().
alternatives.worker_threads: Use Durable Objects, Queues, or ctx.waitUntil() for background work.
alternatives.vm: Dynamic code evaluation is disallowed in Workers.
alternatives.dgram: UDP sockets are not available. TCP is available via connect() from cloudflare:sockets.
alternatives.sqlite: Use D1 or Durable Object SQLite storage (ctx.storage.sql).
alternatives.inspector: Use wrangler dev --inspect or Workers observability instead.
alternatives.fs: There are no project files at runtime. Import JSON/text as modules, or use KV, R2, D1, or static assets.

block.bcrypt: native addon. Use bcryptjs, or PBKDF2 via crypto.subtle.
block.argon2: native addon. Use a WASM build (e.g. hash-wasm) or PBKDF2 via crypto.subtle.
block.sharp: native addon. Use Cloudflare Images or the IMAGES binding.
block.canvas: native addon. Use a WASM renderer or Browser Rendering.
block.better-sqlite3: native addon. Use D1 or Durable Object SQLite storage.
block.sqlite3: native addon. Use D1 or Durable Object SQLite storage.
block.pg-native: native addon. Use pg or postgres with Hyperdrive.
block.puppeteer: launches a local Chrome. Use @cloudflare/puppeteer with Browser Rendering.
block.playwright: launches a local browser. Use @cloudflare/playwright with Browser Rendering.
block.playwright-core: launches a local browser. Use @cloudflare/playwright with Browser Rendering.

warn.jsonwebtoken: relies on Node crypto key objects and is heavy. jose is built on Web Crypto.
warn.express: built around a Node HTTP server. Hono is the common Workers-native equivalent.
warn.dotenv: there is no .env file at runtime. Use vars and secrets in your wrangler config; they arrive on env.
warn.ioredis: needs a long-lived TCP connection. Use @upstash/redis over HTTP or a Workers-native client.
warn.node-fetch: fetch() is built in. Remove node-fetch.
warn.multer: expects Node streams from Express. Use request.formData().

calibration.note: Initial values from Cloudflare documentation. Run scripts/calibrate_matrix.sh to check against workerd.
